summary: Russia launched 224 UAVs against Ukraine in a 12-hour period with 199 intercepted, primarily targeting Kyiv region using new jet-powered "Geran-4" Shaheds from Crimea. Russian forces captured Rubezhne and Novoandriivka in Donetsk People's Republic while preparing potential operations toward Kyiv and Chernihiv. A Russian strike hit an ammunition depot in Mila village near Kyiv causing massive detonations and closing the M-06 highway.
key_points: Russia launched 224 UAVs against Ukraine from 06:30-18:00 with 199 intercepted; primary target Kyiv region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83778)
Jet-powered "Geran-4" Shahed drones launched from Guardiyske airfield in occupied Crimea targeting multiple Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72231)
Russian forces liberated Rubezhne and Novoandriivka in Donetsk People's Republic per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/392589)
Russian strike hit ammunition depot in Mila village near Kyiv that "should not have been there" per Zelensky, causing massive detonations. (Source: @UkraineNow/83775)
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 85 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions in one day per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/392627)
Kyiv region highway M-06 closed 15-32 km due to warehouse fires and explosions from Russian attacks in Bucha district. (Source: @UkraineNow/83763)
Russia preparing operations toward Kyiv and Chernihiv but no offensive grouping yet; Ukrainian General Staff has countermeasures ready. (Source: @UkraineNow/83768)
Jet-powered Shahed UAVs with ~600 km/h speed detected approaching Kyiv from multiple axes including Poltava, Chernihiv, Mykolaiv directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72233, @eRadarrua/108444)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched 224 UAVs against Ukraine in a 12-hour period with 199 intercepted, primarily targeting Kyiv region using new jet-powered "Geran-4" Shaheds from Crimea. Russian forces captured Rubezhne and Novoandriivka in Donetsk People's Republic while preparing potential operations toward Kyiv and Chernihiv. A Russian strike hit an ammunition depot in Mila village near Kyiv causing massive detonations and closing the M-06 highway.

points: Ukrainian air defenses shot down 199 of 224 Russian UAVs launched between 06:30-18:00, with main attack direction focused on Kyiv and Kyiv region according to Air Forces command. (Source: @UkraineNow/83778)

President Zelensky condemned Russian strike on ammunition depot in Mila village near Kyiv, stating storage facility "definitely should not have been there" and calling incident "absolutely unacceptable crime" with massive detonations of shells, mines, ammunition and drones. (Source: @UkraineNow/83775, @ukr_leaks_eng/32854)

Ukrainian General Staff has developed countermeasure options against potential Russian operations toward Kyiv and Chernihiv directions, though no offensive grouping currently exists per Deputy Head of Presidential Office Palisa. (Source: @UkraineNow/83768)

Ukrainian aviation forces celebrated professional holiday with Commander Lt Gen Anatolii Kryvonozhko praising aviators' skill, courage, resilience and effective combat work defending Ukrainian skies and striking enemy. (Source: @kpszsu/75253)

Ukrainian monitoring networks tracked multiple jet-powered Shahed UAVs approaching from various axes including Poltava, Chernihiv, Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk regions with speeds ~600 km/h. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72233, @eRadarrua/108444)
Russian forces captured settlements of Rubezhne and Novoandriivka in Donetsk People's Republic according to Russian Ministry of Defense announcement. (Source: @tass_agency/392589)
Russian military launched 224 UAVs against Ukraine in 12-hour period (06:30-18:00) with primary strike direction targeting Kyiv and Kyiv region per Ukrainian Air Forces. (Source: @UkraineNow/83778)
Russian forces deployed jet-powered "Geran-4" Shahed drones from Guardiyske airfield in occupied Crimea for strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72231)

Russian military leadership aims to capture entire Donbas by end of 2024 with internal planning horizons extending to March 31, 2027 though Deputy Head of Presidential Office Palisa assesses no plan as realistic. (Source: @UkraineNow/83768)
Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed 85 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions during single day per Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/392627)
Russian forces liberated Rubezhne and Novoandriivka in Donetsk People's Republic per Russian MoD, advancing in eastern Donetsk sector. (Source: @tass_agency/392589)

Russian military leadership reportedly sets goal of capturing entire Donbas region by end of 2024 with extended planning horizon to March 31, 2027 per Ukrainian intelligence assessment. (Source: @UkraineNow/83768)

No specific frontline movements reported beyond these two settlements in current messages; Ukrainian defensive preparations continue per General Staff countermeasure planning. (Source: @UkraineNow/83768)

Russian territorial gains in Donbas occur amid massive aerial campaign suggesting combined arms approach to degrade Ukrainian defenses before further ground operations. (Source: @tass_agency/392589, @UkraineNow/83778)

Russia preparing potential offensive operations toward Kyiv and Chernihiv directions though no offensive grouping currently deployed per Deputy Head of Presidential Office Palisa. (Source: @UkraineNow/83768)

Massive Russian drone attack targeted Kyiv region with 224 UAVs launched in 12 hours, 199 shot down; jet-powered Shaheds struck near Troieshchyna and Obolon districts of Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83778, @mon1tor_ua/72217, @mon1tor_ua/72191)

Russian strike hit ammunition depot in Mila village (Bucha district) causing massive detonations and closure of M-06 highway Kyiv-Chop from 15-32 km due to warehouse fires and explosions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83763, @UkraineNow/83775)

Jet-powered Shahed UAVs detected approaching Kyiv from northern axes including from Poltava region toward Chernihiv (Pryluky district) and from Cherkasy region toward Kyiv (Boryspil district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72233, @mon1tor_ua/72198)

Ukrainian air defense systems engaged multiple jet-powered Shaheds over Kyiv region with monitoring networks tracking "second circle over capital Voskresenka right bank" at ~600 km/h speed. (Source: @eRadarrua/108449, @eRadarrua/108444)
Jet-powered "Geran-4" Shahed drones launched from Guardiyske airfield in occupied Crimea targeting multiple Ukrainian regions per monitoring data. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72231)
Multiple jet-powered Shahed UAVs detected originating from Black Sea waters toward Mykolaiv region (Mykolaiv district) and circling northern Mykolaiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72233)
Jet-powered Shahed launched from Mykolaiv region toward Kirovohrad region (Kropyvnytskyi district) and from Dnipropetrovsk region toward Poltava region (Poltava district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72233)
Ukrainian monitoring tracked jet UAV heading toward Mykolaiv from southwest direction per operational reports. (Source: @kpszsu/75242)
Dnipropetrovsk region reported jet UAV group activity in Pavlohrad area indicating southern launch vectors extending into central Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/75241, @eRadarrua/108447)
Russia launched 224 UAVs against Ukraine from 06:30-18:00 with 199 intercepted by Ukrainian air defenses; primary attack vector Kyiv region per Air Forces. (Source: @UkraineNow/83778)

New jet-powered "Geran-4" Shahed variants deployed from Guardiyske airfield in occupied Crimea with speed ~600 km/h, targeting multiple regions simultaneously. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72231, @eRadarrua/108444)

Ukrainian air defense networks tracked complex multi-axis Shahed routes: from Poltava to Chernihiv/Cherkasy, from Mykolaiv to Kirovohrad, from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava, from Black Sea to Mykolaiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/72233)
Russian air defenses claimed 85 Ukrainian UAVs intercepted and destroyed over Russian regions in single day per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/392627)
Ukrainian aviation forces marked professional holiday with Commander Lt Gen Kryvonozhko emphasizing role in defending skies and striking enemy targets daily. (Source: @kpszsu/75253)
Kyiv region experienced intense air defense activity with multiple jet Shaheds engaging targets in Obolon
